{
  "authorities": [
    {"dependency_id":"section-a","evidence":{"quote":"as mentioned under section (A)","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u80.12566"},"needed_for_control":true,"title_or_locator":"Section (A) of SFC circular 26EC35: authentication requirements and qualifications, not supplied here"},
    {"dependency_id":"code-of-conduct-4.3","evidence":{"quote":"paragraph 4.3 of the Code of Conduct","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u93.14715"},"needed_for_control":true,"title_or_locator":"Code of Conduct, paragraph 4.3"},
    {"dependency_id":"vatp-guidelines-11.10","evidence":{"quote":"paragraph 11.10 of the VATP Guidelines","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u93.14715"},"needed_for_control":true,"title_or_locator":"VATP Guidelines, paragraph 11.10"},
    {"dependency_id":"footnote-16","evidence":{"quote":"effective monitoring and surveillance measures16","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u48.7974"},"needed_for_control":true,"title_or_locator":"Circular footnote 16, absent here; potentially qualifies login and device-binding monitoring"},
    {"dependency_id":"footnote-17","evidence":{"quote":"report hacking incidents to the SFC immediately17","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u66.10021"},"needed_for_control":false,"title_or_locator":"Circular footnote 17, absent here; hacking-incident reporting context"}
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "action":"Implement monitoring and surveillance to identify suspicious logins and abnormal trading",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c01",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs should implement effective monitoring and surveillance measures16 to identify suspicious login and abnormal trading activities in their client accounts","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u48.7974"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should implement effective monitoring and surveillance of suspicious login and abnormal trading in client accounts.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":["Footnote 16 is not supplied."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Follow up irregularities",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c02",
      "conditions":["An irregularity is identified."],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"promptly follow-up on any irregularities, including verifying directly with the clients on the transactions conducted and suspending the client accounts (where appropriate).","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u48.7974"}],
      "exceptions":["Account suspension is qualified by 'where appropriate' in this provision."],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should promptly follow up irregularities, including direct client verification of transactions and account suspension where appropriate.",
      "temporal":["Promptly"],
      "uncertainty":["The separate mandatory suspension-or-restriction provision in c17 must also be preserved."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Retain sufficient login and device-binding logs",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c03",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs should implement effective monitoring and surveillance measures16","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u48.7974"},{"quote":"Maintain sufficient logs, including device IDs captured during system login and device binding","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u63.9263"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should maintain sufficient logs, including device IDs captured during login and device binding.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":["No retention duration or quantitative sufficiency standard is specified here."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Review login and device-binding logs for irregular events",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c04",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs should implement effective monitoring and surveillance measures16","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u48.7974"},{"quote":"review them on a timely basis to detect irregular events, such as binding requests from unusual geographic locations, instances where multiple client accounts are bound to the same device and logins from multiple locations within a short period and unusually long login sessions.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u63.9263"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should review logs on a timely basis for irregular events, including unusual binding locations, multiple accounts bound to one device, logins from multiple locations within a short period and unusually long sessions.",
      "temporal":["On a timely basis"],
      "uncertainty":["No fixed review frequency or numerical event thresholds are supplied."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Review and enhance sections (B)–(C) controls",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c05",
      "conditions":["Controls covered by sections (B)–(C)"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs are expected to:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u77.11870"},{"quote":"review their client notification, monitoring and surveillance measures, and response and reporting procedures (as mentioned under sections (B) to (C) above) and make the necessary enhancements immediately to meet the expected standards of conduct.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u78.11917"}],
      "exceptions":["SFC recognises system-update needs and states a pragmatic compliance-assessment approach; see c06."],
      "kind":"TIME",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs are expected to review sections (B)–(C) controls and make necessary enhancements immediately.",
      "temporal":["Immediately"],
      "uncertainty":["'Are expected to' is represented as SHOULD, without upgrading it to MUST.","The complete sections (B)–(C) are not supplied."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Assess compliance pragmatically where systems need updating",
      "actor":"SFC",
      "claim_id":"c06",
      "conditions":["Some internet brokers or VASPs need time to update systems to meet the requirements addressed in u78."],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Nevertheless, the SFC recognises that some internet brokers/VASPs may need time to update their systems to meet these requirements and the SFC will take a pragmatic approach when assessing their compliance;","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u78.11917"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"EXCEPTION",
      "modality":"DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"SFC states that it will take a pragmatic approach to compliance assessment, recognising that some firms need time for system updates.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":["No fixed grace period or waiver is stated.","The qualification appears within the sections (B)–(C) timeline; its application to section (A) authentication deadlines is not established."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Implement robust authentication solutions mitigating phishing-related hacking",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c07",
      "conditions":["Solutions referenced in section (A)"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs are expected to:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u77.11870"},{"quote":"implement robust authentication solutions that can reduce and mitigate hacking risks from phishing attacks (as mentioned under section (A))","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u80.12566"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs are expected to implement section (A)'s robust authentication solutions capable of reducing and mitigating phishing-related hacking risks.",
      "temporal":["Timing is separately stated in c08 and c10."],
      "uncertainty":["Section (A) is absent; login and binding methods, existing-device exceptions, alternatives and performance criteria cannot be determined here.","'Are expected to' is represented as SHOULD."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Complete implementation as soon as practicable and by the stated outer deadline",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c08",
      "conditions":["Implementation of the section (A) robust authentication solutions"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs are expected to:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u77.11870"},{"quote":"as soon as practicable and in any event, no later than\u0000a08 July\u0000a02027 (ie, within 12 months from the date of this circular)","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u80.12566"}],
      "exceptions":["Large internet brokers have an immediate implementation expectation; see c10."],
      "kind":"TIME",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Implementation is expected as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 8 July 2027.",
      "temporal":["As soon as practicable","No later than 8 July 2027","Within 12 months from the circular's date"],
      "uncertainty":["The expectation modality is inherited from u77; the outer deadline remains express."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Define the implementation-period label",
      "actor":"Circular",
      "claim_id":"c09",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"(ie, within 12 months from the date of this circular) (referred to as “the 12-month implementation period”)","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u80.12566"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"DEFINITION",
      "modality":"DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"The '12-month implementation period' refers to the 12 months from the circular's date.",
      "temporal":["12 months from the circular's date"],
      "uncertainty":["The circular's dated heading is not supplied in this piece."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Implement the robust authentication solutions immediately",
      "actor":"Large internet brokers",
      "claim_id":"c10",
      "conditions":["The internet broker qualifies as large."],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"large internet brokers are expected to implement these solutions immediately.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u80.12566"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"TIME",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Large internet brokers are expected to implement the robust authentication solutions immediately.",
      "temporal":["Immediately"],
      "uncertainty":["The definition or threshold for 'large' is not supplied.","This sentence names large internet brokers, not large VASPs."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Incorporate robust authentication methods into internet trading systems",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c11",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"During the 12-month implementation period, internet brokers and VASPs should:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u81.12976"},{"quote":"enhance their internet trading systems by incorporating robust authentication methods","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u84.13066"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"During the implementation period, internet brokers and VASPs should incorporate robust authentication methods into their internet trading systems.",
      "temporal":["During the 12-month implementation period"],
      "uncertainty":[]
    },
    {
      "action":"Adequately test authentication methods before deployment",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c12",
      "conditions":["Deployment of the robust authentication methods"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"During the 12-month implementation period, internet brokers and VASPs should:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u81.12976"},{"quote":"ensure they are adequately tested before deployment;","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u84.13066"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should ensure adequate testing of robust authentication methods before deployment.",
      "temporal":["Before deployment","During the 12-month implementation period"],
      "uncertainty":["Adequate testing and performance acceptance criteria are not specified in this piece."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Roll out robust authentication methods to all clients",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c13",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"During the 12-month implementation period, internet brokers and VASPs should:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u81.12976"},{"quote":"roll out the robust authentication methods to all clients as soon as practicable;","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u85.13213"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should roll out robust authentication methods to all clients as soon as practicable during the implementation period.",
      "temporal":["As soon as practicable","During the 12-month implementation period"],
      "uncertainty":["All-client rollout does not establish whether existing devices require rebinding; section (A) must be checked."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Communicate authentication changes to clients",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c14",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"During the 12-month implementation period, internet brokers and VASPs should:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u81.12976"},{"quote":"communicate the changes to clients","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u86.13303"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should communicate authentication changes to clients during the implementation period.",
      "temporal":["During the 12-month implementation period"],
      "uncertainty":[]
    },
    {
      "action":"Provide client guidance and support",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c15",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"During the 12-month implementation period, internet brokers and VASPs should:","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u81.12976"},{"quote":"provide appropriate guidance and support on the implementation and use of the new authentication solutions.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u86.13303"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should provide appropriate client guidance and support for implementing and using the new authentication solutions.",
      "temporal":["During the 12-month implementation period"],
      "uncertainty":[]
    },
    {
      "action":"Enhance detection of suspicious client-account activity",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c16",
      "conditions":["Implementation-period context, including continued OTP authentication and its phishing risk"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs are also reminded of, among other things, the phishing risk associated with the continued use of OTP for authentication purpose during this 12-month implementation period. In this connection, internet brokers and VASPs should implement enhanced measures to identify suspicious activities in clients’ accounts, including irregular logins and unauthorised trading activities.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u89.13458"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"In connection with implementation-period phishing risks, including continued OTP use, internet brokers and VASPs should enhance detection of suspicious activity, including irregular logins and unauthorised trading.",
      "temporal":["12-month implementation-period context"],
      "uncertainty":["The OTP risk reminder does not itself establish an unconditional permission to use OTP or an OTP-only scope for the enhanced measures."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Suspend or restrict account access immediately",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c17",
      "conditions":["Identification of any such suspicious or potentially fraudulent activities"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Upon the identification of any such suspicious or potentially fraudulent activities, internet brokers and VASPs must take immediate action to suspend or restrict account access.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u89.13458"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"MUST",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Upon identifying the referenced suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity, internet brokers and VASPs must immediately suspend or restrict account access.",
      "temporal":["Immediately upon identification"],
      "uncertainty":["Appears in implementation-period discussion; this piece does not establish that the duty expires with that period."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Notify the case officer-in-charge of anticipated implementation difficulty",
      "actor":"Any internet broker or VASP",
      "claim_id":"c18",
      "conditions":["Anticipates difficulty meeting the 12-month implementation period"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Should any internet broker or VASP anticipate any difficulty in meeting the 12-month implementation period, it should immediately notify its case officer-in-charge.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u90.14040"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"A firm anticipating difficulty meeting the implementation period should immediately notify its case officer-in-charge.",
      "temporal":["Immediately when difficulty is anticipated"],
      "uncertainty":["Notification is not stated to extend the deadline or grant an exemption."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Oversee enhancements and ensure protection of client accounts",
      "actor":"Senior management of internet brokers and VASPs, particularly the Managers-in-Charge of Overall Management and Oversight and of Information Technology",
      "claim_id":"c19",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"their senior management, in particular, the Manager-in-Charge of Overall Management and Oversight and Manager-in-Charge of Information Technology, are ultimately responsible for overseeing the implementation of the abovementioned enhancements and ensuring that client accounts are properly protected.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u92.14239"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"SCOPE",
      "modality":"DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Senior management, particularly the specified Managers-in-Charge, has ultimate responsibility for overseeing the enhancements and ensuring client-account protection.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":[]
    },
    {
      "action":"Seek vendor and IT-security expert assistance",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c20",
      "conditions":["As necessary"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers and VASPs should seek advice and assistance from their system vendors and IT security experts as necessary.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u92.14239"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"SHOULD",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers and VASPs should obtain system-vendor and IT-security expert advice and assistance as necessary.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":[]
    },
    {
      "action":"Implement adequate internal controls and operational capabilities",
      "actor":"Internet brokers and VASPs",
      "claim_id":"c21",
      "conditions":[],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"their obligation to implement adequate internal controls and operational capabilities to protect its operations and clients from financial loss arising from theft, fraud and other dishonest acts under paragraph 4.3 of the Code of Conduct and paragraph 11.10 of the VATP Guidelines.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u93.14715"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"OBLIGATION",
      "modality":"MUST",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"The circular recalls an obligation under the cited Code and Guidelines to implement adequate controls and operational capabilities protecting operations and clients against financial loss from theft, fraud and other dishonest acts.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":["The underlying provisions are not supplied; their detailed scope and qualifications require inspection."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Hold a firm accountable for client losses",
      "actor":"SFC",
      "claim_id":"c22",
      "conditions":["The firm fails to implement adequate measures to prevent, detect and stop large-scale unauthorised client-account transactions following hacking incidents."],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"If the internet broker/VASP fails to implement adequate measures to prevent, detect and stop large-scale unauthorised transactions conducted through client accounts following hacking incidents, the SFC will hold the relevant firm accountable for the losses suffered by its clients.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u93.14715"}],
      "exceptions":[],
      "kind":"SCOPE",
      "modality":"DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"SFC states that it will hold a firm accountable for client losses where the specified failure to prevent, detect and stop large-scale unauthorised transactions occurs.",
      "temporal":["Transactions following hacking incidents"],
      "uncertainty":["The form or measure of accountability is not specified."]
    },
    {
      "action":"Define internet brokers",
      "actor":"Circular",
      "claim_id":"c23",
      "conditions":["Licensed corporations engaged in internet trading","Licensed for one or more of the listed regulated activities"],
      "evidence":[{"quote":"Internet brokers refer to licensed corporations which are engaged in internet trading and are licensed for (i) Type 1 regulated activity (dealing in securities); (ii) Type 2 regulated activity (dealing in futures contracts); (iii) Type 3 regulated activity (leveraged foreign exchange trading); and/or (iv) Type 9 regulated activity (asset management) to the extent that they distribute funds under their management through their internet-based trading facilities.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u106.15585"}],
      "exceptions":["Type 9 activity is included to the extent that firms distribute funds under their management through their internet-based trading facilities."],
      "kind":"DEFINITION",
      "modality":"DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance":"CONTROL",
      "statement":"Internet brokers are licensed corporations engaged in internet trading and licensed for Type 1, 2, 3 and/or qualifying Type 9 activity, subject to the express Type 9 fund-distribution limitation.",
      "temporal":[],
      "uncertainty":["Definitions of VASP and large internet broker are not supplied."]
    }
  ],
  "uncertainties": [
    "This is piece 1 of 5. Missing material may qualify these claims; absence here is not absence of a rule.",
    "Section (A) must be inspected for the actual login and device-binding authentication changes, existing-device exceptions, alternative authentication and unresolved performance criteria. This piece supplies implementation duties and timing but not those substantive details.",
    "The definitions of VASP and large internet broker are absent.",
    "The supplied missing dependencies missing.e11035c5b6b5940b761611d2, missing.03aa9acb4cc86d93b2cad6c4, missing.270d765338256b2d6b1b7fa2, missing.27b60f4bd7a6c54140341057 and missing.51a07230bd02db8bcaafc558 have no titles or source hashes. Their mapping to referenced authorities cannot be established from this piece.",
    "The enclosure is identified but not supplied; its relevance to authentication details or performance criteria is unresolved.",
    "No blanket implementation extension follows from pragmatic compliance assessment or notification of anticipated difficulty."
  ],
  "units": [
    {"claim_ids":["c01","c02"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Login monitoring and follow-up controls qualify authentication operation.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u48.7974"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Transaction-monitoring methodology; does not specify authentication changes or their deadline.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u49.8349"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Threshold-setting context includes device usage and login patterns; no authentication-method criterion is stated.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u53.8537"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Introduces illustrative transaction red flags.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u54.8718"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Trading-pattern, timing and loss red flags support surveillance rather than authentication selection.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u56.8759"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Illiquid and small-cap trading red flag, outside authentication changes.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u57.9019"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Unusual transactions after password reset, contact change or new-device binding are surveillance red flags; no binding exception or authentication method is established.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u58.9124"},
    {"claim_ids":["c03","c04"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Express login and device-binding logging and review controls.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u63.9263"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Section (C) heading identifies incident-response scope for the separate immediate-enhancement timeline.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u64.9698"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Incident-response procedures and immediate containment, asset protection and notification measures; no authentication replacement rule.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u65.9771"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Immediate SFC reporting, root-cause analysis, incident records and remediation are adjacent incident controls; footnote 17 is a missing contextual authority.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u66.10021"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Section (D) client-awareness heading.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u67.10411"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"General client cybersecurity-awareness duty, distinct from authentication implementation.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u68.10526"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Client warnings about credential harvesting and social engineering; no approved authentication alternative is specified.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u71.10728"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Client reminders about compromised credentials and non-disclosure; no login or binding method requirement.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u72.11053"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Regular reminders about passwords, trading controls, alerts and reporting are supporting client practices.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u75.11429"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Implementation-timeline heading.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u76.11843"},
    {"claim_ids":["c05","c07","c08"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Supplies actors and expectation modality for the timeline list.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u77.11870"},
    {"claim_ids":["c05","c06"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Immediate sections (B)–(C) enhancements and pragmatic-assessment qualification must be distinguished from authentication timing.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u78.11917"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Section (D) awareness enhancements are due as soon as practicable; this is a separate timeline from section (A) authentication.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u79.12382"},
    {"claim_ids":["c07","c08","c09","c10"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Authentication implementation scope, outer deadline, period definition and large-broker timing.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u80.12566"},
    {"claim_ids":["c11","c12","c13","c14","c15"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Supplies actors, SHOULD modality and implementation-period scope for following duties.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u81.12976"},
    {"claim_ids":["c11","c12"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"System incorporation and predeployment testing are distinct duties.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u84.13066"},
    {"claim_ids":["c13"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"All-client rollout and as-soon-as-practicable timing.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u85.13213"},
    {"claim_ids":["c14","c15"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Client communication, guidance and support for authentication changes.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u86.13303"},
    {"claim_ids":["c16","c17"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"OTP transition risk, enhanced detection and mandatory immediate account-access action.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u89.13458"},
    {"claim_ids":["c18"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Immediate notification of anticipated deadline difficulty; no extension is stated.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u90.14040"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Management-responsibility heading.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u91.14208"},
    {"claim_ids":["c19","c20"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Oversight responsibility and necessary technical assistance apply to the authentication enhancements.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u92.14239"},
    {"claim_ids":["c21","c22"],"disposition":"CLAIMS","rationale":"Underlying protective-control duties and conditional accountability qualify the implementation context.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u93.14715"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Administrative query contact; not an authentication duty or deadline.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u94.15332"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Issuing division identification.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u96.15466"},
    {"claim_ids":[],"disposition":"CONTEXT","rationale":"Issuing regulator identification.","unit_id":"d501ab149f046.u98.15493"},
